scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @mtg/shared" "npm run dev -w @mtg/api" "npm run dev -w @mtg/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mtg/shared && npm run build -w @mtg/api && npm run build -w @mtg/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @mtg/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @mtg/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
